rows.rationale: Keeps the lament's pronoun shifts and difficult renegade rather than silently naming invaders.
rows.before: On that day they will take up a taunt against you and lament with bitter lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined. He changes the portion of my people. How he removes it from me. To the faithless he apportions our fields.’”
rows.after: On that day people will take up a taunt over you and sing a bitter lament: ‘We are utterly devastated! He exchanges my people’s portion. How he takes it from me! He parcels out our fields to a renegade.’”
